verdict.rationale: Firstbase is a SaaS platform, so API parity with the UI is a fair axis. However, the evidence shows no public API: the only mention is a pricing line item, "Advanced API integrations," which reads as an integration service rather than a documented API mirroring UI actions. Probes for an OpenAPI spec and llms.txt all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
